name: bench-template-cocosair
engineSource: local-tgz (K0: docs/ 剔除版, 冷启动隔离)
buildScript: npm run build (node scripts/build.mjs: esbuild 打包 src/main.js → dist/app.js, cocosair.js external; 复制引擎 module + gltf-decoders → dist/vendor/)
devScript: npm run dev (node scripts/serve.mjs, PORT env 默认 5174, serve 根 = 模板根)
distContract: dist/app.js + dist/vendor/cocosair.module.js + dist/vendor/gltf-decoders/;index.html 经 import map 引擎裸名映射 /dist/vendor/cocosair.module.js
pageContract: window.__appReady(首帧 EVENT_AFTER_DRAW 后 true)+ window.__bench = { getState, reset }
graphicsBackend: WebGL2(引擎默认,失败时 createAirApp 以 WEBGL2_REQUIRED 拒绝)
